facts.value: The California High School Proficiency Examination and other high school equivalency diplomas are recognized as high school diplomas.
Additional high school transcripts or SAT or ACT scores must be submitted to satisfy course competency and aptitude requirements for admission.
Enrollment and successful completion of 24 semester credits with a 2.75 minimum GPA through Earned Admission may be used to satisfy requirements for admission.
Completion of 24 or more college credits from a regionally accredited college or university with a minimum of 2.50 cumulative GPA on a 4.00 scale may be used to satisfy requirements for admission.
